Mold remediation is an area that most homeowners have little or no knowledge, so we rely on the expertise of "mold specialists".  This is an unregulated industry and licensing is not necessary.  So what you have is alot of opinions of what the problem is and how it should be solved.
Do yourself and your pocketbook a favor and at the very least go to www.epa.gov/mold/moldresources.html to begin your education about mold.   Google "mold solutions" and you will find some easy and cheap solutions to at least some mold issues.
Lastly, if you find you do need a mold specialist, get at least 4 estimates and detailed explanations of what will be done, what type of warranty will be given (usually none) and why their approach will resolve your problem.  I guarantee your head will be spinning.

EXCELLENT! Punctual, great customer service, repair conducted at a convenient time for me!

My tenant's oven was not working.  I called All State (aka RC HVAC).  They came out the next day at the time they said they would.  They called me before they started the job which I had asked them to do.  My tenant said he fixed the oven right away.    Their basic service call charge is $35.00 which they credited toward the repair bill of $189.00.  The repair included the cost of the actual thermostat.  I think this is a pretty good price compared to the last appliance repair company I used.    They would not bill me; I had to give them my credit card number before they would do the work.  I have only had one experience with them but I plan to use them again.

angi_reviews.text: DO NOT TRUST THEM. Check Better Business Bureau if you don't want to take my word for it. Scammer, crappy work, left threatening voicemails which I still have.
Royal construction did an excellent work completed my project timely and i would hire them again.

If you are thinking of hiring Royal/Stan, I have one word - "Don't!" He was very convincing but did not come through. I hired him to do a parapet wall on the garage and tuck point some specific areas. Long story short, not sure if he did not know what the parapet wall meant or he was taking advantage of my trust (he assured us this was included in the estimate), but it wasn't touched. When questioned he said that would be extra! His crew left an entire side of the garage unfinished. I had to get them to come back. Three times I had to ask them to fill a gaping hole behind the drainpipe which was a primary concern as noted in the original walk through/estimate. They started to leave before it was done. When I pointed it out, they did a makeshift job. Didn't take the pipe off. The workman LITERALLY threw a big batch of grout behind the pipe (and all over the drain pipe - I have pictures) and called it a day. Check the BBB website if you still have questions.

We had the siding replaced that was damaged as well as work on the gutters and downspouts… We could not have been more pleased with the hard work performed. They responded right away came to take care of the work with immediacy and performed excellent work. Will absolutely call again when needs arise
They were great to work with and had great pricing
It went great! Stan communicates well and his crew were knowledgable and professional. I would hire them again!
Excellent job for a fair price, great customer service, highly recommended! Rafael
Great job, arrived on time , cleaned as they worked. very pleasant easy to work with. answered all my questions. One of the best experiences I've had working with a contractor in a long time .
they gave the best price and best quality you could ask for. Their work is fantastic, good quality and very professional. far exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend them
Stan is professional and very knowledgeable. He gives a fair price for excellent work. His team Peter and crew were always on time and finished ahead of schedule. Excellent worksmanship

I had numerous small spots of tuck pointing crumbling. I had read that construction companies don't like to handle these small jobs but I decided to try. Stan (the owner) came out quickly and looked at the job and told me the same thing. But he gave me an acceptable price and guaranteed his work. He told me that it would be a couple of weeks but to my surprise it was around 1 week. His guys came and quickly did all the spots I had seen and more that I did not notice. They were quick and very polite. Did a great job. Would definitely hire them again
Stan gave me a competitive bid and his crew of Natalia, Carlos and a few others were on time, polite, and did good work!

Royal construction was very efficient and work was done quickly and professionally. They cleaned up area after themselves. They explained everything that they needed to do, and I would call them again. Price was spot on with other estimates.

Excellent - Stan called within 10 minutes of my Angie's list search and showed up on the same day to review and quote the project. The timeline was shifted due to weather but Natalia kept me updated at every step. The work crew were excellent, polite, fast and cleaned up everything before leaving. Stan, Natalia and Carlos all did a great job - Highly Recommended.
Tuck pointing and some concrete repair

It went very well. Stan's crew is excellent, respectful and on time. The work done exceeded my expectation and I make sure that I conveyed that to Stan. Royal Construction have a star in his team. Like i just said, the work done well exceeded my expectation. Nothing more that i could say but WOW!!!!! Thank you Stan!

I should have questioned the pricing, and that is on me, but the real problem is that the employee did not do what was proposed, which was not only to scrape, seal and repaint bubbling places but to repaint entire wall. Instead he painted only over where he had patched. When we noticed it, my wife painted the entire area, a process that took her about four hours (she does a careful and quality job). They were here about 4 hours, so I figure it cost almost $500 an hour. (no complaints about outside sealing so far, except for cost; all they did was remove old tar sealing and replace it with roofing cement).
It was good. He was kinda old; no nonsense. It was still holding after 5 years.
It was very good. They were very timely. They were efficient. They got it all done in a day. They followed up afterwards.
It was good. They were okay.
It was good. They did the work quickly, on time, and the price was fair. The deck was peeled off quite a bit after a year.
They were good, on time, professional and they did a great job. They were courteous and cleaned up after themselves

Very well. Stan contacted me almost immediately after I posted the request for help. He came promptly to see what was needed and provided an estimate. The workers were thorough. It took them 2 trips to complete everything. Stan followed up during and after their work to make sure I was happy with the work. Because of his concern for quality, I knew I would get a good result, which is precisely what happened. I'll use Royal Construciton again whenever the need should arise.

angi_reviews.text: I hired Michael Pape to replace a general contract a large remodel of a house. He provided an early agreement discount at first and informed us that he was able to complete the work (roof replacement, kitchen and bath remodel, hardwood installation and refinish, electrical, and interior paint) in 4-6 weeks. At the end of 10 weeks, only the roof had been completed, which used a sub-contractor of his). This work was completed with very good quality. However, nothing else other than some interior demolition and bathroom tile work had been complete. We called, emailed, and texted and responses were few and far between. We renegotiated the timeline for an additional 6 weeks, but he or his crews never showed up. At the end, we terminated for total non-performance. He won't answer calls and still has a very undeserved amount of money. I would not recommend that anyone use this person for any work. Nothing is complete, work that was performed by him is poor, and he is completely unreliable.
Michael did a wonderful job and gave us a great update to our outdated kitchen. We would highly recommend him and will be contacting him for our future needs!
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for the kind words!  We look forward to the next project!

angi_reviews.text: I was quite apprehensive about hiring anyone to do this, wary of cost overruns and such. Frank, did exactly what we discussed, and then some, but only charged me the amount quoted. He reassured me periodically and answered my questions. Nothing was wasted and they cleaned up thoroughly. The job was done same day despite a rain delay.

After receiving several offers, I chose F & E based on their bid. I was a little nervous because the price was much lower than the other bidders and I was concerned that the service would not be as good.  I couldn't have been more wrong. Frank was very knowledgeable, he was honest and did a terrific job. He took his time and did quality work. He really cares about the quality of his work and does not cut corners.

I got a quote from F & E construction and 2 other companies from Angie's List. Frank's quote was substantially lower than the other quote and he was able to do some work that the other companies couldn't. This garage was in really bad shape and needed a lot of work. I'm very pleased with the results. The siding looks great, and with the new wood, the garage should last for many more years. My neighbors were so impressed that 3 of them asked for F & E do to some work on their houses. In addition, Frank is professional, reliable, and polite. He returns calls promptly, arrives when he says he will, is responsive to requests, and is very conscientious about doing a good job. Frank is also reasonable in his rates, and tries to keep costs down without cutting the quality of the work. I would definitely recommend this company to others and have already lined up my next job with F & E.

angi_reviews.text: UPDATE: Chicago Star Roofing has been asked to, but refused to comply and assist with the insurance claim to fix the damage their work has caused to my home. This will no doubt cause further damage as I have to work harder to correct their poor workmanship.

Have been fighting with them for over a year and a half to fix an improper roof installation. Had an independent roofing inspector come for an insurance claim, and the problems they found, and the evidence of the work Chicago Star Roofing claimed they completed left me speechless. Every time it rains or snows, it rains inside my house now. Do not use this company!

Great work and service. They performed four separate jobs for me over two days - repair to the garage roof, repair to the front porch roof, parapet tuckpointing repair, and flat roof patching. They took the time to explain the requirements for each job in detail. Their crew was quick and very professional.

The Chicago Star Roofing team was great to work with; they were incredibly responsive. We discovered a leak in our ceiling Sunday night and they were at our house on Monday morning helping us work the problem. They identified the issues, provided clear and concise recommendations and provided a fair quote for the work, which was completed that day. I'm keeping their number on my shortlist of service providers.

Kelly was great. We had a leaking coming into a 6th floor unit from the roof, and, with the fast service (reviewed the job on Friday) and repair (completed the next day), we caught a lucky break in the weather. Now we are good to go for this week's projected snow and/or rain. The workers were knowledgeable and efficient, and all materials were removed. Chicago Star deserves their A rating.
Kelly and his team were able to schedule extensive roof work on very short notice. They completed their work quickly and I hardly noticed their presence during the project.

These guys were great. I got multiple quotes for our roof tear off and deck replacement. They were very competitively priced and provided a detailed description of the project. The work was done on time and in a clean manner. They were also very friendly and considerate. I would recommend them to anyone looking to do a roofing project.

They arrived on time and were very professional. The patiently explained what was needed and even did extra. I was also very please with the warranty that they gave me which exceeded what others had quoted.

I had a sudden and large leak in the roof. They were the first company to quickly respond to our emergency inquiries. They came out, cleared off the roof, and patched it up. We had them return in nicer weather to finish fixing up the roof and to apply a reflective coating. We will be using them for roofing needs in the future. They provide warranty on their work. They are fairly priced. They do not try to over sell on unnecessary work. Wonderful people skills. Quick to respond to questions. They are professional, friendly, and timely!

I had used a previous company who failed to fix the leak and instead tried to up-sell me on other projects. I contacted Chicago Star Roofing and requested an honest evaluation of the leak and quote for repair. Kelly responded immediately and Frankie showed up right on time. He took the time to listen to my concerns and provided the diagnosis I was looking for. The quote was fantastic and the leak was repaired the same day. Chicago Star Roofing is my go-to for repairs and I highly recommend their services!

The experience with Chicago Star roofing was great. We had a leak in our roof on a Saturday that was leaking water into the house from melting snow and ice. We used Angie’s list contact us service and Chicago Star responded within 10 minutes. Since we had water coming into the house, they came out the next day moved all the melting snow and ice, and patched up all the effected areas. They offered a free estimate and a reasonable quote for next day service. We paid upfront, because we didn’t know if we wanted to file a claim, but after assessing the water damage we changed out minds and filed the claim. Kelly worked with us to have the roof covered with insurance and get the invoice reimbursed. We will definitely use them again for our next project.

angi_reviews.text:
Started with our closing in April.  The house was a mess.  We met Moe outside of the house at 7am with the keys.  He had six guys with him that started the demolition right away.  My wife and I were very active in the entire process, and I can tell you that Moe was very patient with me in particular.  I can be a little difficult at times(Just ask my wife).  Moe handled the entire project with professionalism, and was excellent at assisting us with obtaining just about all of our wants without going even a penny over budget.  I think the best part about the entire project was the Moe was exceptional when it came to offering alternatives that would save on the budget, and still keep our wants.
Since the project, we have called Moe for other services.

angi_reviews.text: They never did the job and wouldn't refund us the money. They didn't really do almost anything and they walked off the job and left us in an awful situation. They also got verbally abusive and wouldn't refund us. They did paint a couple of rooms, but the quality was so poor. I could have done a better job.
The painter was good, he knew his craft. However, owner did not make it clear that the square footage was wall space, not floor space.

Not having a general contractor in place, I needed someone that was easy to work with, and of course delivered quality work at the right price.  I purchased an Angie's List deal from TMCM for complete interior repainting, and prior to the paint job, I included them on 1 of 3 estimates I farmed out for extensive repairs to the interior walls (mostly plaster, some drywall) that were torn up from replacing the electrical system, and general old age (cracking) .  TMCM proposed a very fair price for the wall repairs, so I hired them as well for the additional work.

The end result was fantastic - I feel like I have a new house on the interior.  Plaster repair was top-notch, and the paint job was great too.  For all the little "things" (requests) that pop up in the course of an extensive renovation, TMCM was easy to work with and for all these reasons, I'll recommend them to anyone, and keep their number for future work.

Painting was not completed as desired. Many incomplete areas with paint splashes and spills on floor (the latter was cleaned up by their cleaning crew when I complained). Painter was let go and several others were asked to complete the work but none did a great job and still many areas not completed. I stopped the process and will finish it myself.

Workman show up at 9 a.m. We talked about what we wanted done, I am sure he already knew but wanted to make sure we were on the same page as his info. Layed tarps down and started the demolition. Moved electic and put in the ceiling electric. Dry walled off the walk in area and then reversed the door to open outward. Patched seams with joint compound and left for the day. Back 9:30  next morning, Finished up putting molding around door and checked to make sure joints were finished properly. Hung new lighting fixture. Cleaned up and took trash out to the back.
Thorough, fair price, on-time.

angi_reviews.text: Horrible. Did not show multiple times at time scheduled to start work. Gave my key to a total stranger that owner hired to do work when I was told he was doing the work. Repair to walls was poor quality as all cracks reappeared within 6 wks after they finished. Scheduled to return to inspect the reappearance of cracks and was a no show no call Will and has not respond to my calls, texts or messages in any way.

Angie's List scammed my family of $425. It kept - and continually refuses to refund - for services never provided or available to the gullible "members" who believed they were dealing with a reliable business.

The company never returned any of the half dozen calls I made to it. Seems likely their offer became oversubscribed, or honoring the offer would have been unprofitable for them, so they simply stopped answering their phone. Angie's List refunded my money in full and downgraded the company's rating to reflect the recent unhappy experiences of numerous would-be customers.

They left a lot of walls and materials that had mold on it. They didn't encapsulate the mold. They did not pull the mold out of door frames. They didn't seal my vents or use properly use hepa filters, they just opened my window. He blew mold all over the unit. He also used duct tape to cover my vents. They also did not do the fogging at all. I sent him a letter outlining how he failed and only paid him 50%. I had to hire another company to finish the work.
Gave an estimate, gave a date to start the work, never showed back up. I put down a deposit, and now he won't answer or return calls.

Horrible! The most stressful experience I have ever had with any contractor! The contractor was suppose to come back to finish the job at 8AM on Friday on property that I was moving into on Saturday. I gave him a key to the property that he subsequently gave to a total stranger (another contractor to finish the job) and he did not show up until 8pm to do the work. This meant I had to stay at the residence until 12am! He did return the next morning, which was move in day! I paid movers to move me in who had times that they were idol because the painters were in the way. The work is done substandard as I am now seeing uneven areas. If I could get a refund I would definitely request one!!!

I hired this company to paint the interior and exterior of my home. They did come out and paint the interior of my home, when I called to schedule for the outside of my home, the owner would not return my calls. I've been trying to call and schedule for four weeks with no return call. Finally I was able to get a hold of the owner and I asked for the remaining portion of my money back from the work that had not been done. He agreed to send me the remaining portion two weeks ago and I still have not received a check.

IKG's service was superior in quality just as they promised it would be. The crew that came were personable and polite, they cleaned up the area near the attic access when the job was finished. Tom and his company are affordable and knowledgeable, they answered all of our questions and gave us tips on how to sell our home faster as well. We would recommend IKG to all those seeking fast, affordable, and quality mold solutions.
Quick and easy for a one bedroom. Price was on the higher end but I got what I payed for. Great guys to work with.

2 bathrooms were painted. Took them about 5-6 hours with two guys. They have some guys that really know what they were doing when it comes to cutting around objects. Excellent company for anyone who needs painting.

My basement flooded with all the rain we have been getting lately and I needed someone to come in quick with an ideal price. This is who I chose and they were here for three days. Did clean work and felt like little work on my end. Good work for good price!

Tom came over to give me a quote and the price was cheaper then my other two quotes so I decided to go with them on the spot. Chose my color schemes and they were here on a Saturday with a small crew of three guys. They were very nice and nice to talk to. Tom explained the process and the type of paint they were using. Benjamin Moore paint, and they finished in 1 day and left no mess behind. Very clean work. Good company to use, and very informed throughout the process. 5/5

angi_reviews.text: Mark's Roofing was AWESOME! I contacted them on Friday afternoon to schedule an estimate on having some siding repaired on a garage. They scheduled the estimate for the next morning Saturday. They arrived on time and gave an estimate that was more than 50% cheaper than all other estimates that I received.  They were so friendly and customer service was top notch.  I was really impressed because they cared so much about if I was satisfied. They came out on Monday morning and the work was completed in about two hours.  They also had to do a little more work than was quoted and they did it for no additional charge. They did an amazing job it looks like brand new and there was a lot of damage to the garage from a fire.  My neighbor was also so impressed and asked for their number so that they can have some work done.  I've never done a review before but I had to give them their kudos.  I would highly recommend Mark's Roofing, they were excellent.

angi_reviews.text: David, the owner, was knowledgeable and seemed like a good guy. I was there the day they began and everything seemed to be going along fine. I left around 2:30pm and found it odd that they were working on the garage at 8:30pm in the dark but I had faith that they were professionals. I had left the final payment and was told that I would be sent the receipt and final pictures. I haven't received anything. There are a couple of issues that need to be addressed so I contacted David via phone and text with no response. At this point I have no receipt/warranty and work that needs to be addressed. Do not fall for David's good guy act, he is only a good guy until the check clears.

Dave at Alpha Roofing was initially very responsive. I received 4 quotes - Alpha was not the cheapest but reasonable- I went with them because I liked Dave. The new roof appeared to have been installed well but after a rain storm, I realized that the gutters were not installed properly (slanting the wrong direction) and gutter guards were not put back on. I reached out to Dave consistently for 3 months and he will not respond or fix the issue, as required by the warranty. I would recommend looking elsewhere - a company that has been in business for longer and will stand by their work.

Dave was a joy to work with. He let me know everything that was going on step by step. I was in dire need of a new roof for my brothers house and Dave came through for me. Needed it done as quickly as possible . Crew was friendly and cleanup was great. Nice people to do business with. If I ever need a new roof I will be calling Dave (Alpha Roofing). Thank you for a job well done.
